behaviors.description: The wampa has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. At the start of each wampas turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (4d4) poison damage.

name: Swamp Wampa
sectionText: Wampas are semi-sentient predators with humanoid proportions that stand up to 12 feet tall. While they all share characteristics in common, there are three variations of wampa that are distinct based on their native planet.
